package.name: uav_farm_survey
package.description:
A single hector quadrotor surveying an orchard row by row with a downward-looking camera, finding ripe fruit by colour and reporting where each one is in world coordinates.
The point of the package is that the fruit positions are never told to the robot. The world is generated, so the true position of every berry is known and written to config/orchard_truth.yaml - but that file exists so the run can be *scored*, not so the drone can cheat. What the drone gets is an image, its own pose, and a camera model.
